key_findings: OTULIN is upregulated in trigeminal ganglia after IONL; overexpression raised head withdrawal thresholds and reduced IL-1β, TNFα, CGRP, while knockdown worsened pain.
OTULIN inhibits the NLRP3 inflammasome via autophagy activation (reversed by 3-MA).
